title: Waivers and agreements
emptyHelp: Add the waiver or agreement members sign when they join. Use New template to write it or upload a PDF.
versionNote: Publishing creates a new version. Existing signed copies keep the exact document that was signed.
saveError: Could not save. The template may have changed; close and reopen it before trying again.
name: Template name
unsigned: No signed copies for this member
pdfError: Could not prepare the PDF. Please try again.
signError: Could not sign. Check the signer, guardian, signature, and commitment date. If the template changed, close and review it again.
guardianNote: A guardian must sign for a member under 18 or whose date of birth is unknown.
guardian: I am signing as a parent or guardian
typed: Use my typed name as my signature
draw: Draw your signature, or choose the typed-name option above.
consent: I have read this text and agree to sign it electronically.
documentConsent: I have read this document and agree to sign it electronically.
documentHelp: Open the document to read it in a new tab if needed. Confirm only after you have read it. If it will not open, contact the gym before signing.
documentLimits: Up to 10 MiB and 20 pages. Plain web, email and page links are allowed. Use a PDF without passwords, forms, attachments or active content.
documentRetryBody: The server is busy. Wait a minute, then reload this document. Read it before signing; if it still will not open, contact the gym.
documentUnavailableBody: Return to the signing page and open the document again. Read it before signing; if it still will not open, contact the gym.
documentUploaded: PDF uploaded and validated. Pages: {pages}. Bytes: {bytes}.
